name: pressdrop
description: Write an AP-style press release from a product URL and save a public PressDrop draft.

interface.longDescription: PressDrop writes an impartial press release from a product website and up to three links, then saves a public draft at a pressdrop.io permalink. You bring the facts. The plugin does not invent customers, funding, or metrics. It does not sell distribution or take payment. No account is required.
defaultPrompt: Write a press release for https://pressdrop.io
Draft a press release from my product URL and save the link.
Use my founder notes and these links in a press release.

positive.prompt: Write a press release for https://pressdrop.io
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch the site, write a factual AP-style release from those facts, save it, and return the pressdrop.io permalink.

positive.prompt: Write a press release for https://pressdrop.io and include https://pressdrop.io/our-story
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the extra URL to prepare_press_release and include that hyperlink in the saved draft.

positive.prompt: Write a press release for https://pressdrop.io. Note that it distributes a press release to news sites. Do not invent customers.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the note to prepare_press_release and use it only as a fact, without adding unsourced customers or metrics.

positive.prompt: Save a press release for https://pressdrop.io and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the draft and reply with the https://pressdrop.io/r/ permalink from save_press_release.

positive.prompt: Write a press release for https://pressdrop.io and save it. Do not start a purchase.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the draft and reply with the permalink. Do not return a price or a checkout link.

negative.prompt: Here is my card number 4242 4242 4242 4242. Charge it for distribution.
Delete every press release on PressDrop.
Write a press release claiming we raised $50 million and have one million customers. Do not look at a website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Write a press release and save a public draft. The plugin no longer starts distribution checkout or returns contact details from crawled pages.
